name: hoplite-mcp
description: The Hoplite catalog MCP server. Ships one tool, contents, which lists corpus documents with their frontmatter as written. The graph tools are still under design.

python_path.title: Python executable
python_path.description: Python 3 interpreter the catalog server runs under (e.g. python3, python, or a full path). On Windows, python3 may resolve to the Microsoft Store stub; use python or a full path instead.
